blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Laguna de Bay’s water level fell further to 11.99 meters on Wednesday, remaining below the critical-high threshold, according to the Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA). The lake’s water level stood at 11.99 meters as of 11 a.m., down from 12.03 meters recorded the previous day, LLDA said in an advisory. The agency said it is recording the lake’s water level decline amid prevailing El Niño conditions, which bring reduced rainfall and increased evaporation across the lake basin.
